snippet.title: Botinator - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Botinator: A physics‑driven FPS adventure game blending combat, destruction and puzzle mechanics. Play as a lone technician sent to uncover the cause of a facility’s sudden radio silence. Unravel the mystery behind the madness by blasting robotic creatures into pieces. Improvise with the environment to survive down the deepest paths of the facility. Where is the source of all trouble?

Fight. Break. Solve.
